heading: Snippets, SFTP alignment, and guide improvements
summary: Fix the ⌘P Snippets shortcut, simplify SFTP file rows, and make the Quick Guide easier to scan.
changes: The terminal shortcut opens Snippets consistently. Terminal Triggers remain on their own toolbar button.
Remove duplicate row actions, align file columns, and clarify access to local and connection-specific path favorites.
Separate instructions into readable steps, complete translations, and cover the transfer queue and folder comparison.
The CLI now reads an opted-in token from the correct PromeFTP app data folder, with owner-only permissions.
notice: Requires macOS 13 or later on Apple Silicon. Saved agent tokens remain local and are never written into skill files.
